verdict.rationale: Windmill documents Git sync: each deployment creates and pushes a commit to a repository, and new commits can be auto-deployed back into a workspace. It also supports CLI deployments from Git and a Compare & Deploy page. Together these cover versioning through source control and imply a deploy path. Explicit multi-environment (dev/staging/prod workspace) promotion is not directly documented in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dev-to-prod workspace promotion, environment-specific configuration handling, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version workflows through source control or environments and promote changes from dev to production

citations.quote: Each time an item is deployed, Windmill will create and push a commit to the specified repository. ... Windmill can automatically deploy new commits from the repository into the workspace
as well as CLI deployments from a Git repository
it opens the Compare & Deploy page with exactly those items preselected, ready to deploy
Flows additionally expose version-pinned webhook endpoints that target a specific flow version by its numeric version ID
